items.title: Brain Tourniquet Unleash Fearsome New Concept Album Sinking Deeper Into Madness
items.summary: My wife got back from work just now, walked into my office, and asked, " What are you listening to?" When I told her, she was like, " Brain Tourniquet? Well, A for effort on the name." She's right. That name rules. Even if you don't like th abrasive music that Brain Tourniquet make, you have to respect what they bring to the game.
